_desc: Critiques and suggestions for Isaura (buying-agent). LLM-agnostic — no model/provider names. Any LLM can read, update, or version this file.
_format_rules: LLM names never appear — judge by merit, not origin.
Each review is a self-contained block; merge/version by updating items + bumping version.
vN increments per sprint/pivot; superseded reviews archived to reviews/archive/.
All decisions align with Cérebro (Claude Opus) rulings.
Any LLM can edit this file via git commit + push. See AGENT_WORKSPACE.md.

source_a.title: Próximas implementações alpha
source_a.trigger: Request: suggest next implementations before alpha launch

source_b.title: Diagnóstico: o que trava o alpha

items.detail: Resend free tier (3k/mo). Steps: create account → Add Domain → izzza.app → DKIM → copy key to .env.

items.summary: Domain izzza.app not bought — webhook has no public endpoint
items.detail: Without domain, Evolution API webhook has no public target. Buy via Cloudflare Registrar (~R$30/yr). DNS A record → server IP.

items.summary: Z-API not tested with SIM Claro — risk of R$89/mo wasted
items.detail: Free trial first. Connect SIM Claro, test webhook POST SERVER_IP:3099/webhook/whatsapp. Only pay after validation.
Local SQLite (free, 3 tables: users, requests, cache). No order history, no vision cache. Minimal schema to run.

sections.label: BUGS READY TO FIX (no external blocker)

items.detail: Product comparison images arrive as 50px thumbnails. 1-line patch: change `w_50` to `w_800` in Cloudinary transform param.

items.summary: SQLite cache for Gemini Vision descriptions
items.detail: Cache image descriptions by hash to avoid double-paying Gemini Vision. Table: vision_cache(image_hash, description, created_at).
GET /health returning status of: WhatsApp (Evolution API), Gemini, Cloudinary, Resend (email). Essential for monitoring.
Post-.env script that restarts Isaura and runs smoke test (ping /health, send test WhatsApp). Usage: `npm run smoke`.

sections.label: ALPHA SURVIVAL KIT
sections.priority: P1 — don't crash with first user

items.detail: SQLite table request_log: timestamp, phone, input_type, intent, latency_ms, success(bool), error. Essential for blind debugging.
If external service fails, respond: "Recebi. Vou analisar manualmente e já te retorno." — never silence, never crash.
Timeout on entire WhatsApp-response pipeline. Alpha criterion: <30s total. 25s leaves 5s margin.

items.summary: Crash guard: error → WhatsApp response + log, never kill process
items.detail: try/catch at entrypoint: any exception becomes friendly WhatsApp response + structured log. Process never dies.
"pesquisar [item]" → search & compare. Send photo → Gemini analysis. "resumo" → conversation digest. No menus, short onboarding.

items.summary: Short WhatsApp reply first; PDF/comparison after
items.detail: First response is direct WhatsApp text. Detailed PDF only on request. First-response latency is the metric.
SQLite handles alpha. Migrate later.
Fixed cost $22/mo. Spread only when beta validates ROI.
Zero need for 1 user.
Governanta uses WhatsApp. Dashboard is distraction.
n8n :5678 runs already. Complex workflows later.
Basic auth suffices. OWASP audit post-alpha.
Reproducibility goal, not alpha blocker. Commit after.

items.summary: Repo is docs-only — zero source code committed
items.detail: No .ts, no package.json, no src/ on GitHub. Real code at /home/a/Desktop/workspace/isaura (local, unversioned). If server dies, product dies with it.
items.fix: Claw: cp -r src/ package.json tsconfig.json ./isaura/ && git add . && git commit

items.detail: Hermes references a goals file that doesn't exist in the repo. Index inconsistency.

items.summary: No docker-compose.yml in repo — zero reproducibility
items.detail: Evolution API, n8n run in Docker with no committed IaC. Another dev/machine can't reproduce.
items.fix: docker-compose.yml with Evolution API + n8n + Redis + app.

items.detail: Port 3099 can go down silently. No heartbeat, no alert.
items.fix: Hermes cron: GET /health every 5 min, alert if != 200.
